name: export-dashboard
title: Excel dashboard
description: Excel project controls dashboard of a P6 project (one A3 page and detail sheets), then a short summary of its cards, counts, failed DCMA checks and warnings (the database is never written). Use when the user asks for an Excel dashboard or a one-page project report.

args.name: project
args.description: Project ID as shown in P6

args.name: path
args.description: Full path of the .xlsx file to write

args.name: baseline
args.description: Project ID of the baseline (empty = the project baseline)

args.name: prepared_by
args.description: Name printed under the title (may be empty)

args.name: revision
args.description: Revision printed under the title (may be empty)

args.name: company
args.description: Company name in the sidebar (may be empty)

args.name: colors
args.description: Colors 'primary,accent' in hex, for example 1F3864,C00000 (may be empty)
